news.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after sentiment across the broader software and cybersecurity space continued to improve amid receding fears of artificial intelligence disruption.

news.headline: Cloudflare Soars 6% as PHP Flaw Hitting 70% of Websites Lifts Security Stocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare stock rose 6% and Datadog rose 7% today after PHP patched two critical flaws in software that runs an estimated 70% of websites. Cloudflare gave every customer firewall rules against the known attacks, including free users, which shows why its place in front of millions of sites is valuable.

news.headline: PHP patches critical flaw hitting 70% of websites; Cloudflare, others surge
news.summary: Investing.com -- PHP released emergency patches today fixing two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities rated CVSS v4.0 9.2, affecting every web server running PHP 5.4 or later — a population spanning an estimated 70% of the world’s websites.
